children: PepsiCo elected Joaquin Duato to its Board as an independent director and named him to the Audit Committee, effective December 1, 2026.
Independent Member of the Board; Audit Committee member
Chairman and CEO of Johnson & Johnson since 2023/2022; director since 2022; prior roles include Vice Chairman of Executive Committee and Worldwide Chairman, Pharmaceuticals; with J&J since 1989.
Will serve on the Audit Committee, effective December 1, 2026

Initial award of 1,000 shares of PepsiCo Common Stock; prorated annual equity award equal to $166,667 divided by closing price on Dec 1, 2026 (phantom stock units); annual cash retainer with first semi-annual payment of $60,000 in June 2027.
